# Human-voice fixture attribution

All clips are openings of LibriVox public-domain audiobook recordings (standard LibriVox disclaimer, different human narrator per clip). No private recordings.

- **expressman-male-us.wav** — The Expressman and the Detective by Allan Pinkerton, read by a male US narrator. Source: LibriVox (public domain), https://archive.org/details/prideandprejudice_1107_librivox — 16-second opening disclaimer, resampled to 16 kHz mono.

- **janeeyre-female-uk.wav** — Jane Eyre by Charlotte Brontë, read by a female UK narrator. Source: LibriVox (public domain), https://archive.org/details/prideandprejudice_1107_librivox — 16-second opening disclaimer, resampled to 16 kHz mono.

- **tomsawyer-male-us-2.wav** — The Adventures of Tom Sawyer by Mark Twain, read by a male US narrator. Source: LibriVox (public domain), https://archive.org/details/prideandprejudice_1107_librivox — 16-second opening disclaimer, resampled to 16 kHz mono.

- **prideprejudice-female-uk-2.wav** — Pride and Prejudice by Jane Austen, read by a female UK narrator. Source: LibriVox (public domain), https://archive.org/details/prideandprejudice_1107_librivox — 16-second opening disclaimer, resampled to 16 kHz mono.
